name: Hau'oli
source:
After a fatal car crash, you find yourself waking up in the body of a cat and found by Sialia, a Spotted Hyena. Over the course of 5 days, you learn about Sialia's life and help her through a difficult time.

[From [url=https://night-fox-works.itch.io/hauoli]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一场致命车祸后，你在猫的尸体中醒来，并被斑点鬣狗希莉亚发现。在5天的时间里，你了解了Sialia的生活并帮助她度过了困难时期。

[来自[url=https://night-fox-works.itch.io/hauoli]itch.io[/url]]
